# b3-v1 card 3 — strategist, 2026-11-21 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

NO CHANGE. Protection at target; none of the candidates closes a gap better than its cut.
- Weakest axis: what happens after a wrath / edict / Armageddon, which Concealment half covers; no single non-GC card fixes it; rule 1 (let it resolve with Tithe) is the piloting fix (strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance, strategy:resource-hedging).
- Words of Wisdom for Stroke: NO. Psychosis Crawler counts YOUR draws; Stroke at X is the scalable self-draw (X pings); Heliod's discount cheapens Stroke's X; Words is fixed and too small to kill with. Words only as an addition.
- Archive for Leyline: NO. Heliod's flash is back-face only and rule 2 expects him removed; Leyline is free in an opener, gives Approach / Mathemagics / Prosperity / Fascination instant speed without Heliod (the 003 hand). Archive a fifth MV-5 artifact, a third doubler mattering only while the Crawler lives.
- Mine / Dictate / Font: KEEP, on-plan (feed Rhystic, Tithe, discount, Scrawling tax every round; Dictate's flash best; Font the 6-card outlier). The liability — feeding a B4 table — is a table read, not a cut (strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw).
- Isochron Scepter: a real card (12 imprints; Counterspell / Silence / Swords / Truce repeatable at {2}); no two-card infinite.
- Runner-up: none this round. Dissent: slow cheap draw too small vs a B4 table; NO CHANGE leaves the Armageddon hole, which no non-GC card closes.
Open: stack scenario Mathemagics + Insight + Crawler; forge-cast-check Concealment; Stroke at an opponent vs at yourself under the discount — untested.

# Draw doublers compound; Words of Wisdom; Leyline vs Heliod — rules-question, 2026-11-21 (saved by Jarvis)

(a) Two doublers (Insight + Bard, or + Archive) COMPOUND: one would-be draw becomes four (614.5 — one opportunity each, but the second may replace the modified event; 616.1 affected player orders; rulings: Archive 2015-06-22 "four times", Bard 2026-06-29 "multiplied by four", Teferi's 2020-06-23). Insight's exception keeps the first draw-step draw single. Psychosis Crawler triggers per card (121.2; ruling 2011-06-01): "draw two" → 4 cards / 4 triggers under one doubler, 8 / 8 under two.
(b) Words of Wisdom on an opponent's turn with Heliod out: you draw 4 under Insight (4 Crawler triggers); each other player draws 1 (not doubled — "If YOU would draw"); those 3 opponent draws count for Heliod's discount on any spell you cast later that turn (no "my turn" limit; 601.2f lock-in), trigger Tithe ×3 and Scrawling Crawler ×3. Your own draws never count for Heliod.
(c) Leyline of Anticipation and Heliod's flash are redundant permissions (601.3, 702.8a); Leyline matters only while the back face is not on the battlefield.

Asked: card three for b3-v1 — the one in and one out, or NO CHANGE — weighing Words of Wisdom for Stroke of Genius, Alhammarret's Archive for Leyline of Anticipation, the draw-step trio (Howling Mine, Dictate of Kruphix, Font of Mythos), Isochron Scepter, and which axis is next weakest now that protection reads 5 (at, 5-7). Answer: NO CHANGE on the nonland slots. The audit on the branch (sha 7f98f262) reads under on four axes — colour-sources -3 (blue 33 of 36 sources), mana-base 35 against the control frame's 37-39, sweepers 2 against the frame's 5-7, interaction-breadth 4 of 5 (land) — and not one of the cards asked about touches any of them: Words and Archive add to card-advantage (15 against 10), Leyline is the deck's only flash source for permanent spells when Heliod is gone (log 001 and 003 are exactly that game), the trio is the discount's static supply (five opponent draws on each opponent's turn with all three out), and Scepter has twelve legal imprints in the branch and two on-thesis engines (Vision Skeins, Mystical Tutor), so it is a real card, not a leftover. The one measured gap a single card does close is in the land base — a 36th land that makes both colours — and that is a land-pass patch with its own instruments (mana-fit, mana-analysis), offered as the runner-up for the pilot to take or leave, never forced into card three.
